dsgvoSectionIntro: The following information is only a template. The operator must adapt it to the real data processing. And to the laws in their country.
dsgvoLegalBasisText: The learning progress is only saved if you say yes. It is only stored in your browser (localStorage). It is not sent to a server. You can also allow anonymous statistics (voluntary, via the cookie banner). But the operator needs a server for this. [Here the operator must enter the real legal basis.]
dsgvoRetentionText: [Here the operator must enter how long data is stored.] Data in your browser stays only with you. You can delete it anytime.
dsgvoRightsText: The law gives you many rights. Here are the most important:
dsgvoRightAccess: You may ask: What data do you have about me?
dsgvoRightRectification: You may have wrong data corrected.
dsgvoRightErasure: You may request that your data is deleted.
dsgvoRightRestriction: You may request that your data is no longer used.
dsgvoRightPortability: You may get your data. In a form you can use.
dsgvoRightObjection: You may say no to processing. You can object at any time.
dsgvoRightWithdrawal: You may take back your consent any time. It is just as easy as saying yes. At the bottom of every page, there is "Cookie settings". Click it. Then you can change your choice. If you turn off saving your learning progress, your saved progress is deleted. You can also do this in the settings: turn off "Save Progress". The button "Delete all data" in the settings takes back all your consents at once. Then the cookie banner asks again.
dsgvoRightsContact: If you want to use one of these rights, please write to:
dsgvoComplaintText: If you think the site operator is doing something wrong with your data, you can complain. The responsible authority for this website is:
dsgvoContactText: If you send a message, the site operator reads it and replies to you. The message is not given to others. Afterwards it is deleted. You do not have to give an email address. But then no reply is possible.
dsgvoLocalStorageText: The website saves a few things in your browser. Only with you. Not on a server. These are the things:
dsgvoLocalStorageCookiePrefs: Your choice in the cookie banner or in the settings. Whether your learning progress may be saved. And whether you allow statistics.
dsgvoLocalStorageProgress: Which quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths you finished. All of this is stored together in one place. But only if you said yes. Without a yes, it only lasts for this visit. If you say no, it is deleted.
dsgvoLocalStorageTheme: How the website should look. For example light or dark. And which color.
dsgvoLocalStorageLang: Which language you chose. And whether you use Plain Language.
dsgvoLocalStorageFont: Which font you chose. For example the OpenDyslexic font. It is easy to read.
dsgvoLocalStorageFeedback: Your messages from the feedback page. Also your name and your email address. But only if you typed them in. There are 50 messages at most. You can delete the messages on the feedback page.
dsgvoLocalStorageMore: A few other things. Also only with you. For example: your favorites for the tools. Which news you have already read. And your settings for the playground.
dsgvoLocalStorageTechnical: And a few technical things. They say nothing about you. For example: which version of the website you had last.
dsgvoLocalStorageNote: How to delete everything: Go to the settings. There is the button "Delete all data". It deletes all these things. Then the page loads again. You can also use your browser settings. Important: When there is a new version of the website, your data stays.
